name: Stature Alchemy method

card.summary: A height-increase program sold through YouTube that is aimed at making people taller, discussed on looksmaxxing forums, with its contents not publicly documented.
card.note: Paid program whose contents are not public; adult height is largely genetic.

quick.overview:
Stature Alchemy is the name of a height-increase method promoted on YouTube by a creator of the same name. Its promotional claim, as relayed on looksmax.org, is a path to 6 ft 6 (about 198 cm).

The goal is a taller standing frame, a major looksmaxxing target. The method is sold as a product, so its details are not public, and forum members have speculated about what it contains.
quick.how: From the discussion, forum users say the program is paid and that they have not seen its contents. One reply guessed it relies on subliminal audio and said such methods only work if used consistently; this is a user's guess, not a description from the seller.
quick.risks: No harms are documented. Forum participants note the method is sold commercially and that they could not verify what it involves.

lead: Stature Alchemy is a height-increase method marketed through YouTube. A looksmax.org thread describes it as a 'new 6ft 6 method' by a creator called Stature Alchemy, and the original poster asked for a leak of its contents, saying they felt bad about hurting the seller's business.[1]

Replies in the thread offer guesses rather than details. One user said the method is 'SUBLIMINALS' and added that it works if followed consistently.[1] Because the program is sold and its contents are not published, no independent description exists.

chain: Buy and follow a program promoted on YouTube
angle.text: Buyers hope to gain height beyond what their growth would otherwise give them. The seller's claim is a large gain, up to 6 ft 6 as relayed on the forum, though the method itself is not publicly described.

paras: The method is promoted by a YouTube creator named Stature Alchemy and discussed on looksmax.org in a thread titled for a 'new 6ft 6 method'.[1] The thread's participants do not describe the contents of the program; the original poster asks for it to be leaked, which implies it is behind a paywall.[1]

A reply in the thread suggests the method consists of subliminals, audio with messages meant to be heard below conscious attention, and says it works with consistency.[1] That is one user's characterization.

sections.h: Background on height and subliminal audio
paras: General background on height: twin studies place the heritability of adult height at 60 to 80 percent, and growth typically reaches zero around age 15 to 16 in females and 18 to 19 in males.[2]

On subliminal audio in general, the Wikipedia article on subliminal stimuli notes that evidence for auditory subliminal effects on behavior remains weak, and a study of subliminal self-help audio found effects largely indistinguishable from placebo.[3] These are studies of the broader category and not of this program.

lore.intro: On looksmax.org the method is discussed as a paid product whose secrets members want revealed.[1]

claims.claim: The method can take someone to 6 ft 6.
claims.believers: The thread title presents it as a 'new 6ft 6 method', and the original poster is eager enough to see the contents to ask for a leak.[1]
claims.experts: No published studies have tested this program. Adult height is highly heritable and growth generally ends by the late teens.[2]

claims.claim: The program works through subliminal audio if used consistently.
claims.believers: One forum reply said 'SUBLIMINALS' and that it works if you are consistent.[1]
claims.experts: Reviews of subliminal stimuli describe evidence for behavioral effects of auditory subliminals as weak.[3]
